dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: Hello, dear guests! Please, right this way!

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: A certain astrologically-adept friend of Madame Mage has prepared you a gift!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! What a sparkly crystal ball! Looks expensive, too... How much do you think Margaret would pay for it? Ten million — no, twenty million Mora!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... Sorry, Paimon was just messing around! Anyway, what's it for?

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: In the words of Madame Mage's friend: "Where there are mages, one must surely have crystal balls worth the name." With its help, my dear guests will be able to set foot on a wonderful new stage...

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: Now, I'm not really sure what she meant — I am just the concierge, after all! All I ever see when staring into a crystal ball is my reflection...

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: Ah, right! There's also this box, another gift from Madame Mage!

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: "If you can put on a spectacular performance on this hidden stage, one as unpredictable as the tides of fate themselves, you shall discover the wondrous treasures this little box contains"... At least, that's what she told me.

dialogues.speaker: Wolfy
dialogues.text: Well, that's all from me! It wouldn't be sporting for the concierge to spoil the intrigue for you all, dear guests. So please, take the stage in your usual gallant fashion!
